text.tspan: T1/T2 2-N16 TRIMMERS EACH SIDE OF OPENING
1. ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES AND LEVELS IN METRES (AHD) UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
2. CONCRETE N40. COVER TO REINFORCEMENT 50 UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
4. LAP LENGTHS 50d MINIMUM UNLESS NOTED OTHERWISE.
5. BAR DIMENSIONS ARE TO BAR CENTRELINE. MINIMUM INTERNAL BEND DIAMETER 5d (AS 3600 TABLE 17.2.3.2); SCHEDULED LENGTHS ALLOW FOR BENDS.
6. REINFORCEMENT INTERRUPTED BY OPENINGS SHALL BE CUT AND TRIMMER BARS PROVIDED AS SHOWN.
7. PIPE PENETRATIONS SHALL BE SEALED WITH NON-SHRINK GROUT AND FLEXIBLE JOINT TO PIPE SUPPLIER'S DETAILS.

8. COG = STANDARD 90° COG TO AS 3600 CL 13.1.2.7, LENGTH AS SCHEDULED (SHORTENED WHERE LIMITED BY SLAB DEPTH). SLAB BARS COGGED AT BOTH ENDS (BOTTOM BARS UP, TOP BARS DOWN); WALL VERTICAL BARS COGGED INTO ROOF SLAB.
9. STEP IRONS GALVANISED OR PLASTIC ENCAPSULATED TO AUTHORITY STANDARD, AT 300 CTS, 350 WIDE, 150 PROJECTION.
10. DRAFT GENERATED BY LYNHCADTOOLSBOX - TO BE CHECKED BY THE DESIGN ENGINEER.
